lines.zh: 我的牙一步一步啃着地面。
lines.en: My teeth chew the ground step by step.

lines.zh: 牙关一开一合，我蹭着地面挪。
lines.en: My fangs clack open and shut as I scrape along.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，却不怕死。
lines.en: I have one sliver of life and no fear of death.
One point of health, still enough to bite.

lines.zh: 触角轻微摆动，观察环境
低头沉思，似乎有所计划
偶尔转动触须，感受气息
触须轻轻摆动，警惕四周
我张着嘴，等召唤者下一步指令。
lines.en: Mouth agape, I wait for the summoner's order.

lines.zh: 我挂在半空，一开一合咬空气。
lines.en: Hanging in air, I bite at nothing.

lines.zh: 我是一颗牙，还没有身体。
lines.en: I am a tooth without a body.

lines.zh: 不动的我，像一枚落地的牙。
lines.en: Still, I look like a fallen tooth.

lines.zh: 立刻转向玩家，锁定目标

lines.en: Eyes lock on, ready to attack
Stares at player, ready to devour

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，随时准备扑击
lines.en: Locks onto player, ready to pounce
Turns to player, ready to attack
I open toward you like a mouth.

lines.zh: 我嗅到你的血，牙根发麻。
lines.en: I smell your blood and my roots tingle.

lines.zh: 我的牙尖对准你的喉咙。
lines.en: My points aim at your throat.

lines.zh: 我朝你张开，像一道伤口。
lines.en: I open toward you like a wound.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛，也知道你在哪。
lines.en: Eyeless, I still know where you are.

lines.zh: 我贴在你脸旁，等你呼吸。
lines.en: I hover by your cheek, waiting for breath.

lines.zh: 你数我的牙，我数你的心跳。
lines.en: You count my fangs; I count your heartbeats.
I split a seam and grin at you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你肩膀转了一圈。
lines.en: I circled once around your shoulder.

lines.zh: 尖牙在你身上留下伤痕。
我的牙碎了一颗，其余还咬。
lines.en: One tooth shatters; the rest still bite.

lines.zh: 我散了一半，剩下还在动。
lines.en: Half of me scatters; the rest still moves.

lines.zh: 你靠近了我巢穴的边缘！
lines.en: You're getting close to my hive!
I have more teeth than you!

lines.zh: 别让我生气，我只有一滴血也咬。
lines.en: Do not anger me; with one point of health I still bite.
Don't get close to my antennae!
I burst up behind your heel.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，也要咬你。
lines.en: One point of life, and I still bite.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下去，我咬住了鞋底。
lines.en: You stomp down; I bite the sole.
We grow up side by side in the soil.
Tooth against tooth counts as company.
You can't interfere with my mating!

lines.zh: 我们两颗牙挨着，就算成双。
lines.en: Two fangs side by side count as a pair.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，可牙很多。
lines.en: One sliver of health, but plenty of fangs.

lines.zh: 我只有一颗心，咬一口就散。
lines.en: One heart left; I bite once and scatter.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱起，围成半圈。
lines.en: I arch out of the soil into a half ring.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经认准你的手腕。
lines.en: My teeth have chosen your wrist.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，也够咬你。
lines.en: One point of health is still enough to bite.
The summoner pointed at you; I came.

lines.zh: 你的血肉在我齿间作响。
lines.en: Your flesh rattles between my teeth.
I need no reason, only a bite.

lines.zh: 我只有一颗心，咬完就散。
lines.en: One heart, one bite, then I'm gone.
You have been given to me.
Fangs in place, prey in range.
Draw near, you will be destroyed!
I form a ring and tighten it.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，牙却很多。
lines.en: One point of health, and many teeth.

lines.zh: 我只剩一点血，也够咬你。
lines.en: One sliver of health is enough to bite.
I circle you with fangs turned inward.
Raise a hand and I bite the wrist.

lines.zh: 我贴地潜行，等你露脚踝。
lines.en: I skim the ground, waiting for an ankle.
I spin faster, like a millstone.
Every gap is lined with my fangs.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我正好收口。
lines.en: Back into the corner and I close in.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的影子，再咬你。
lines.en: I bite your shadow first, then you.
Listen: that clatter is my jaws.
My one drop of life for one wound of yours.
One instant left before I snap shut.

lines.zh: 尖牙闪现，恐惧随之而至。
咬破你的皮，吞噬你的魂。
lines.en: Bite through your skin, devour your soul.
Deathly fangs extend in the dark.

lines.zh: 撕裂你的肉，吞噬你的血。
lines.en: Rip your flesh, drink your blood.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的猎食者，致命一击。

lines.en: One bite down and the blood is warm.

lines.zh: 我的牙碎了一颗，你也疼。
lines.en: A fang breaks, and you hurt too.
Your flesh is stuck between my teeth.
I clamp down until I am gone.

lines.zh: 我碎成渣，也要留个牙印。
lines.en: Even crumbling, I leave a bite mark.
That blow cost me half my life.

lines.zh: 无尽的黑暗，致命的生物。
吞噬者被召唤，恐惧随之。
吞噬者被召唤，恐惧降临。
召唤的圈里，我凭空咬合。
lines.en: In the summoning ring I snap into being.
I am hauled out of the void.

lines.zh: 第一件事，就是找最近的肉。
lines.en: First thing: find the nearest flesh.

lines.zh: 我只有一滴血，也够咬一口。
lines.en: One drop of life is enough for a bite.
The summoner raised a hand and I took shape.
A row of teeth surfaces in the dark.
I was shaped for biting, nothing else.

lines.zh: 落地时，我先咬了一口土。
lines.en: Landing, I bite the dirt first.
The fangs arrive before the body.

lines.zh: 我出现在你脚边，张着嘴。
lines.en: I appear at your feet with my mouth open.
Summoned fangs fear open flame most of all.

lines.zh: 我被爆炸震得昏头转向。
我只有一点血，一箭就够。
lines.en: I have only one point of health; one arrow is enough.

lines.zh: 饥饿把我的牙磨得更尖。
